# vaultwarden_organization_collection_user (Resource)

This resource gives an organization user access to a collection.

Access of other users and groups to the collection is left unchanged. Users with access to all collections (`Owner`, `Admin`, or a `Manager` with `access_all`) cannot be assigned to individual collections.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vaultwarden_organization" "example" {
  name = "Example"
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_collection" "example" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  name            = "Example Collection"
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_user" "example" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  email           = "user@example.com"
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_collection_user" "example" {
  organization_id      = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  collection_id        = vaultwarden_organization_collection.example.id
  organization_user_id = vaultwarden_organization_user.example.id
  read_only            = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection_id` (String) ID of the collection
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization
- `organization_user_id` (String) ID of the organization user, for example `vaultwarden_organization_user.example.id`

### Optional

- `hide_passwords` (Boolean) Whether passwords are hidden from the user. Defaults to `false`
- `manage` (Boolean) Whether the user can manage the collection, including its access. A `Manager` that can edit the collection and see its passwords can always manage it. Defaults to `false`
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the user can only view the items in the collection. Defaults to `false`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the collection access, in the format `<organization_id>/<collection_id>/<organization_user_id>`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vaultwarden_organization_collection_user.example <org_id>/<collection_id>/<organization_user_id>
```
